---
title: "Research"
---

My research goal is to build wireless systems that communicate according to the needs of downstream tasks. In emerging 6G networks, users, vehicles, sensors, and edge intelligence modules will exchange information not only for connectivity, but also for sensing, inference, and real-time decision making. This requires communication protocols and resource allocation methods that account for timeliness, task utility, reliability, and computation constraints.

## Research vision

I am interested in **freshness-aware and task-oriented wireless intelligence**. Instead of optimizing a single physical-layer metric, my work studies how wireless systems can decide what information is useful, when it should be updated, and how limited wireless resources should be allocated across communication, sensing, and computation tasks.

This vision connects three directions:

::: {.research-grid}
::: {.research-card}
### Semantic and task-oriented communication
Designing communication strategies that preserve task-relevant information and reduce unnecessary transmission overhead.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Information freshness
Using Age of Information and deadline-aware metrics to characterize when delivered information remains useful.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Integrated 6G resource allocation
Jointly considering communication, sensing, computation, beamforming, power control, scheduling, and learning-based optimization.
:::
:::

## Current research themes

### Task-oriented semantic communication

Task-oriented semantic communication shifts the objective from bit-level reconstruction to task-level utility. My work studies how communication policies can be designed according to inference deadlines, information value, and the requirements of downstream sensing or decision tasks.

### Age of Information and timeliness-aware networking

Age of Information provides a system-level view of information freshness. I study how AoI and related timeliness metrics can guide scheduling and resource allocation when updates have heterogeneous deadlines, reliability requirements, and task importance.

### Integrated sensing, communication, and computation

6G systems are expected to support communication, sensing, and edge intelligence over shared resources. I am interested in integrated frameworks that coordinate spectrum, power, computation, and sensing requirements, especially in systems where information freshness affects task performance.

### NOMA and multicast/unicast coexistence

Non-orthogonal multiple access and multicast/unicast transmission can improve spectrum efficiency, but they also create coupled design problems involving beamforming, decoding order, interference management, and power allocation. My work explores optimization and learning-based approaches for these systems.

## Application areas

- Vehicular networks and C-V2X
- Edge intelligence and mobile inference
- Integrated sensing and communication
- Freshness-aware scheduling and control
- Semantic and task-oriented wireless systems
- Learning-based wireless resource allocation

## Keywords

6G, wireless communications, semantic communication, task-oriented communication, Age of Information, NOMA, ISAC, ISCC, C-V2X, edge intelligence, resource allocation, reinforcement learning.
